narrative.overview:
4VD is two apps for one family shop and its carwashes (4VD = "4 Vëllezërit Dacaj", the four Dacaj brothers): the dashboard to run the shop and the team app to sell at the counter. They are one product with one language and one look.

Ink on ivory paper with oat panels, one clay brand colour, tactile keys and the shop at sunrise. Structure, data and interaction are crisp and modern (Cloudflare's dashboard, SBB's rigour); paper, a serif for titles, rubber stamps and the sunrise are the vintage finish (anthropic.com's calm). Calm at rest, clear when touched.
keyCharacteristics: Ink on ivory paper; raised cards, inset fields and tactile keys (never flat), one soft light from above, never a coloured gradient.
One clay voice (`#d4704f`): the logo, the sunrise, the one primary key per screen, progress and the current menu item.
Source Serif 4 only for page titles and the day's headline; Hanken Grotesk for everything else, every figure tabular; monospace capitals for stamps and spec labels.
Status colours are earthy and quiet (sage, ochre, brick, slate) and always come with words; data is drawn in ink.
Tables stand on the page under a heading, never inside a card. Zero is said in words; big sums drop their cents.
Dates read day / month / year (`13/10/2026`) everywhere; Activity is written in the reader's language.

rules.name: One Clay Voice
rules.body: Clay marks brand, action and place only: the logo, the sunrise, the one primary key per screen, progress and the current menu item. Badges, links and charts are never clay.

rules.name: Ink Data
rules.body: Charts and figures are drawn in ink; one value far above the rest is capped with a break mark so the others stay readable.

rules.name: Words With Status
rules.body: A status colour always comes with its word, in a stamp or a sentence; meaning never rests on colour alone.

rules.name: No Box In A Box
rules.body: A table is its own framed surface: a section is a heading on the canvas plus the table, never a card around it.

rules.name: Depth, Not Decoration
rules.body: Only Raise, Inset, Key, Float and Glass; never an invented shadow or glow, never a coloured gradient.

rules.name: Calm Zeros
rules.body: Emphasis never goes to zeros, decoration or disabled things: an empty figure is a calm sentence at body size.

rules.name: Busy Keeps Its Word
rules.body: A working button keeps its label with a spinner beside it and can't be pressed twice.

rules.name: Day Month Year
rules.body: Every date reads day / month / year, typed or picked; never month-first, never ISO on screen.

rules.name: Same In Both Apps
rules.body: Stamps, stock tags, segmented controls, keys and wording match between the dashboard and the team app.

dos: **Do** read `DESIGN.md` first; it is the one rulebook for both apps.

**Do** build dashboard pages from `admin/src/components/ui/` (PageHeader, Card, Section, DataTable, StatTile, MetricCard, Badge, Button, Field, DateField, EmptyState) and team-app screens from `mobile/src/components/ui.tsx` (Button, Stamp, TextField, EmptyState, ErrorState).
**Do** use tokens from `admin/src/styles/tokens.css` and mirror them in `mobile/src/theme.ts`.
**Do** give every screen hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty and error states.
**Do** keep tap areas at least 44px on phones.
donts: **Don't** put a table inside a card.
**Don't** use a coloured gradient, glow or invented shadow, or leave a surface flat.
**Don't** print 0 at figure size or show cents on a headline figure of €1,000 or more.
**Don't** use the browser's native date box or a month-first date.
**Don't** use clay for anything but brand, the main action and where you are.
